TRY_CAST(SALARY_TO AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN (TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) + TRY_CAST(SALARY_TO AS DOUBLE)) / 2.0 WHEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) > 0 THEN TRY_CAST(SALARY_FROM AS DOUBLE) WHEN flatten comma-separated employment types into individual rows LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(SPLIT(b.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME, ',')) e AS emp_type -- flatten JSON array of education levels into individual FROM expanded """) cleaned_df.createOrReplaceTempView("job_postings_clean") cleaned_df.toPandas().to_csv("salary_cleaned.csv", index=False) spark.sql("SELECT * FROM job_postings_clean LIMIT
